items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yes. This is something that nobody knows. Yes it did. Could it be Albert Nicklaus? [INTERVIEWEE] I had forgotten all about him. I see.

ctx.x: Yeah. Uh Richard M Jones. I had forgotten all about him. That's true. Richard M Jones. He played piano. Uh huh. And uh let's see. Yeah. I can't think. Who played the clarinet at that time? Well now that I put the question in your mind, it may suddenly bob up two days from now. It might.
Yes. This is something that nobody knows. Yes it did. Could it be Albert Nicklaus?
I had forgotten all about him. I see.
